evidence_items.explanation: Workday reports that 62% of surveyed AI users said their stress or burnout risk decreased. This cautions against a uniform-harm account, but the sponsored, cross-industry survey does not settle the narrower tech-worker causal claim; its fieldwork dates are not supplied in this release.

unresolved_gaps: No representative June 2026 estimate establishes the alleged mental-health epidemic among tech workers.
No reviewed study isolates exposure to misleading statements by Altman, Amodei, or their backers as the cause.
No reviewed evidence establishes knowing falsity for the unspecified capability statements.
Earlier reports of strain cannot establish the prevalence of the condition at the post date.
